## recv-wazuh-alert (contract C1, N8N-1.1)
**Trigger:** POST /webhook/wazuh-alert from the Wazuh `custom-n8n` integration, header `X-ASOX-Token` required (403 without it, N8N-1.6). Answers 200 on receipt (C1 has a 10 s timeout and no retries).
**Inputs:** raw Wazuh alert JSON (body). The full alert stays in this execution (the C1 check looks for it here).
**Actions taken:** reads lib-config; drops alerts below WAZUH_ALERT_MIN_LEVEL ("filtered: level ..."); skips intake exclusions (TEMPORARY: rule group sca, "skipped: sca (X-09)"); routes every other alert with lib-route-alert (Router de Playbooks, N8N-1.3: playbook and case template from lib-config `routing`; the route is recorded in "Playbook input") and calls the chosen playbook by ID without waiting, passing the route. A routing failure (broken table) parks the alert with its id through lib-error.
**Systems changed:** none here (the playbooks change TheHive).
**Approval:** not applicable.
**Owner:** n8n.
Error workflow: recv-n8n-error.
